name: smallcap_breakout
plain: A small cap trading above its 20-day high.

implementations.label: scanner momentum_small flag
implementations.note: Ranks 16-60 of the top-60 by 24h volume, px > hi20 AND (vol_ratio > 2 OR up-day > 1.5x exp_move).

implementations.label: terminal.html planner warning
implementations.note: vol_rank > 15 and px > hi20 only (no volume/up-day condition), LONG side.

implementations.label: laptop prereg (PREREG_SMALLCAP_FADE)
implementations.text: Universe: HL perps outside the top 15 by trailing 20-day dollar volume at that hour (prior bars only), >=25 eligible coins. Signal: close / max(close over the prior 480h) - 1 >= 0.04, strictly above. Benchmark: same-hour eligible coins NOT above their 20-day high.
implementations.note: Outside top 15 by TRAILING 20d $ volume; >= 4% above the prior 480h max close.
